lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 12 to 15 high-luminance circular spots are visible on the lateral flank, arranged in an irregular grid with approximately three identifiable vertical columns and four horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Prominent vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, forming distinct grid-like anchor nodes across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high-luminance dorsal edges to shadowed ventral edges.

other_distinctive_markers: A high concentration of smaller, densely packed high-luminance spots is visible on the cranial region, transitioning into a larger grid pattern on the flank. Multiple small, low-luminance elongated objects (commensal organisms) are visible in the water column surrounding the pectoral fin.
